turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Northwind Financial, my name is Marcus. Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The mobile app crashes every time I open the statements tab.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry about that. Which phone are you on, and what app version?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: An iPhone, and the version says six point two point one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's a known issue on six point two point one. Version six point two point two went out this morning and fixes it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Let me update. Okay, it's installing.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: While that runs — statements are also available on the web portal if you need one right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It opened fine after the update. Thanks for the quick answer.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Glad that sorted it. Have a good day.
